businessModel: Bundled with Windows; no direct revenue (search deals only)
updateCadence: Discontinued; IE11 released 2013-10-17; consumer support ended 2022-06-15
summary: Microsoft's default Windows browser from 1995; IE11 was the final version (2013). Desktop support ended June 15, 2022 and Windows 11 disables it. Legacy sites now run through Edge IE mode.
bestFor: Legacy intranet sites via Edge IE mode (not IE itself)
notFor: Anyone needing modern web standards or security patches

pros.title: Deep enterprise controls
pros.detail: Group Policy and IEAK enabled rich enterprise management.

pros.title: Legacy app compatibility
pros.detail: Ran ActiveX and old intranet apps; Edge IE mode continues this to at least 2029.

pros.title: Preinstalled
pros.detail: Shipped with Windows NT 4.0 through Windows 10 21H2.

pros.title: Tiny footprint
pros.detail: No separate download; part of Windows.

cons.title: No longer supported
cons.detail: Retired for Windows 10 SAC on June 15, 2022; Windows 11 disables the normal launch path.

cons.title: Security risk
cons.detail: Unpatched on consumer Windows; ActiveX and BHO attack surface.

cons.title: No extensions ecosystem
cons.detail: Only legacy add-ons (ActiveX/BHO), nothing compatible with current web.

signatureFeatures: Enterprise Mode and Edge IE mode

faq.a: Support ended June 15, 2022 for Windows 10 Semi-Annual Channel editions; IE 11 was the final release.

faq.q: Can I still use IE-only sites?
faq.a: Yes, through Microsoft Edge IE mode, which Microsoft has committed to support through at least 2029 with one year notice.
Windows 11 disables the normal way of launching it.

timeline.event: Internet Explorer 1 launched with Plus! for Windows 95
Edge Legacy replaces IE as default browser in Windows 10
IE11 support end on Windows 10 LTSC 2021 / IoT (2032-01-13)

switching.note: Modern browsers import IE favorites; Edge adds IE mode for legacy sites.

installSize: Preinstalled with Windows, no separate download
securityHardening: Trident attack surface plus ActiveX/BHO; EPM sandbox dated
advancedSettings: Group Policy / IEAK depth for enterprise

unverified: Only two sources (both Wikipedia); Microsoft lifecycle page not fetched
